csv_project_name: Db Svc for FY26 National Roofing Program
csv_scope_of_work: The Scope of Work (SOW) is for the design and construction services required to repair failed or failing roofs in the United States Army Reserve Command (USARC) roofing inventory under the NRP FY25 Project 11 Design-Build Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Building Envelope, Roof Repair and Replacement Construction in Support of the U.S. Army Reserves National Roofing Program (NRP), Army, and Air Force Reserve Sections.

title: Design-Build Services for FY26 National Roofing Program
short_description: Design-build roof repair and replacement services for U.S. Army Reserve facilities in Montgomery, Alabama.
project_scope: Design and construction services to repair failed or failing roofs within the United States Army Reserve Command roofing inventory under the National Roofing Program. The procurement is part of a design-build multiple award task order contract for building envelope, roof repair, and replacement construction supporting Army and Air Force Reserve sections. No building size, roof area, or technical span data is provided.
services: Design-build services for building envelope works, roof repair, and roof replacement construction under a MATOC.
relevance_explanation:

- No indication of complex load-bearing structures, long spans, or architecturally demanding design.
- Falls close to excluded MEP/building-envelope type work rather than sbp core structural engineering focus.
- Design-build format offers some planning component, but the technical scope remains low relevance for sbp.
